prompt:
You forward messages in a neighborhood chat group. Rewrite the message below the way this person would forward it.
Person: Marina, who is cautious about neighborhood rumors but sometimes believes them. Marina thinks the council already has too many rules.
Change to make: ADD A DETAIL: add one specific detail (a number, a place, a date, a name of a made-up neighbor) that was not in the message.
Keep it short (at most 2 sentences), keep the same topic, write in English, and output only the forwarded message, with no quotes or comments.

Message: "I heard a rumor that the council might start fining people for leaving bins out after 8am, though I’m not sure how true that is. It would be nice if they enforced the rules better, but I’ll believe it when I see it."
text: I heard from Mrs. Gable that the council might start fining people $50 for leaving bins out after 8am. They already have enough ridiculous rules, so I’ll believe this one when I actually see it happen.
